name: Onchain Finance Portfolio
summary: Hold the companies whose product is money — exchange, credit, yield, payments and privacy — rebalanced across Base, Ethereum and Robinhood Chain
description: A weighted basket of seven onchain finance names: HYPE and UNI (exchange), AAVE and MORPHO (credit), SKY (yield), CRCL (payments, as a Robinhood stock token) and ZAMA (privacy). Deposit USDC on Base; the agent invests it across the basket, bridges USDC to Ethereum by CCTP and to Robinhood Chain (USDG) by Across, and rebalances toward the target weights. The thesis and the fundamentals behind each position are in the README.
strategy: Invest every USDC deposit in proportion to fixed target weights (cbHYPE 20%, CRCL 20%, UNI 14%, AAVE 14%, MORPHO 14%, SKY 14%, ZAMA 4%). Trim any holding more than 10pp over target weekly; buy under-target holdings with idle settlement currency in basket order; pool cross-chain shortfalls into one bridge per run (CCTP to Ethereum, Across to Robinhood Chain) and confirm every arrival on-chain. A scheduled run keeps ticking until the portfolio is settled.
mandate: ExactInputSwapPermission (Uniswap V3 / Aerodrome, settlement in and basket tokens out and back, recipient pinned to the Safe, 1,000 per buy), BoundedErc20Approve (approve only, basket tokens and settlement, to the routers, the CCTP messenger and the Across SpokePool), CctpBridgePermission (USDC only, 1,000 USDC per tx, Base and Ethereum, mint recipient pinned to the Safe) and AcrossBridgePermission (depositV3 only, USDC↔USDG between Base and Robinhood Chain, depositor and recipient pinned to the Safe, 1,000 per tx, output floor at 30 bps, empty message).
author: aadopico
